name: Shenzhen Bsc Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Bsc Technology Co.,Ltd. specializes in the end-to-end process – from conceptualization and engineering to manufacturing and distribution – of essential components for electronic devices. Their product portfolio includes a variety of specialized components such as safeguarding and dust-resistant elements for electronic products, alongside solutions for insulation, adhesion, thermal management, and shock absorption. Beyond components, the company also provides advanced manufacturing equipment, including automated assembly systems, precise gravity-controlled pressure jigs, specialized locking fixtures, high-precision multi-angle cable bending tools, and automated cutting and bonding machinery. These offerings cater to a wide array of applications, encompassing smartphones, smart wearables, general consumer electronics, and the automotive sector. Established in 2016, the firm is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
